tools.name: teamgate_list_users
tools.description: List the Teamgate users of the account with id, name and username. Use the ids as owner_id filters and values. GET /users.

tools.name: teamgate_get_user
tools.description: One Teamgate user by id. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_list_leads
tools.description: List or search leads (unqualified prospects) with owner, status, source, industry and contact details. Filter by name, email, phone, status, owner, source, star or creation date. GET /leads.

tools.name: teamgate_get_lead
tools.description: One lead by id with all its details. GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_list_lead_statuses
tools.description: List the lead statuses of the account (use the names as the status filter or value on leads). GET /leadsStatuses.

tools.name: teamgate_list_people
tools.description: List or search people (contacts) with job title, company, owner, source and contact details. Filter by name, email, phone, owner, customer status or creation date. GET /people.

tools.name: teamgate_get_person
tools.description: One person by id with all their details. GET /people/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_list_companies
tools.description: List or search companies with owner, industry, source, customer and prospect status and contact details. Filter by name, email, phone, owner, VAT code or creation date. GET /companies.

tools.name: teamgate_get_company
tools.description: One company by id with all its details. GET /companies/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_list_company_people
tools.description: List the people who work at one company. GET /companies/{id}/people.

tools.name: teamgate_list_deals
tools.description: List or search deals (sales opportunities) with value, stage, status, owner and expected closing date. Filter by name, status, stage, owner, source or creation date. GET /deals.

tools.name: teamgate_get_deal
tools.description: One deal by id with value, stage, status, owner, buyer and dates. GET /deals/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_list_deal_stages
tools.description: List the pipeline stages that one deal can be in (id, name, win probability; the deal's current stage is marked selected). GET /deals/{id}/stages.

tools.name: teamgate_list_contact_deals
tools.description: List the deals that belong to one person or one company. GET /people/{id}/deals or /companies/{id}/deals.

tools.name: teamgate_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines (id and name). Use teamgate_get_pipeline for the stages of one. GET /pipelines.

tools.name: teamgate_get_pipeline
tools.description: One sales pipeline by id, with its stages. GET /pipelines/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_list_activities
tools.description: List activities (tasks, calls, appointments and notes) across the account. GET /events.

tools.name: teamgate_list_record_activities
tools.description: List the activities (tasks, calls, appointments, notes) linked to one lead, person, company or deal. GET /{leads|people|companies|deals}/{id}/events.

tools.name: teamgate_get_activity
tools.description: One activity (task, call, appointment or note) by id. GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_search
tools.description: Search leads, people, companies and deals by name in one request. GET /global.

tools.name: teamgate_list_sources
tools.description: List the lead/deal sources of the account (where records come from). GET /sources.

tools.name: teamgate_list_industries
tools.description: List the industries of the account. GET /industries.

tools.name: teamgate_list_products
tools.description: List the products of the catalogue (id, name, price). GET /products.

tools.name: teamgate_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom field definitions of the account (id, name, type, module). GET /customFields.

tools.name: teamgate_create_lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a lead. Give a person's name, or a company_name for a company lead. Teamgate may start workflows or notifications for new leads. POST /leads.

tools.name: teamgate_update_lead
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one lead. Only the fields you pass are sent; this overwrites their current values. PUT /leads/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_create_person
tools.description: WRITE: create a person (contact). Optionally link them to a company with their job title. POST /people.

tools.name: teamgate_update_person
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one person. Only the fields you pass are sent; this overwrites their current values. PUT /people/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_create_company
tools.description: WRITE: create a company. POST /companies.

tools.name: teamgate_update_company
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one company. Only the fields you pass are sent; this overwrites their current values. PUT /companies/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_create_deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal for a buyer (a person or company). POST /deals.

tools.name: teamgate_update_deal
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one deal, for example move it to another stage or mark it won or lost. Only the fields you pass are sent; this overwrites their current values. PUT /deals/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_create_activity
tools.description: WRITE: create a task, call or appointment, optionally linked to leads, companies or deals. Teamgate may send reminders to the owner. POST /events.

tools.name: teamgate_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to one or more leads, companies or deals. The note cannot be edited or removed with these tools. POST /events.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: teamgate_list_leads, teamgate_list_people, teamgate_list_companies · Private data: teamgate_list_leads, teamgate_list_people, teamgate_list_companies, teamgate_list_contact_deals, teamgate_list_record_activities, teamgate_list_sources, teamgate_create_person · Public sink: teamgate_list_leads, teamgate_list_people, teamgate_list_companies, teamgate_create_lead, teamgate_create_person, teamgate_create_company, teamgate_create_deal, teamgate_create_activity, teamgate_add_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: teamgate_list_leads, teamgate_list_people, teamgate_list_companies · Private data: teamgate_list_leads, teamgate_list_people, teamgate_list_companies, teamgate_list_contact_deals, teamgate_list_record_activities, teamgate_list_sources, teamgate_create_person · Public sink: teamgate_list_leads, teamgate_list_people, teamgate_list_companies, teamgate_create_lead, teamgate_create_person, teamgate_create_company, teamgate_create_deal, teamgate_create_activity, teamgate_add_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
